title: A kinetic model of copper homeostasis in Saccharomyces cerevisiae.
authors: Dulaney, Cade; Walton, Jay R; Lindahl, Paul A
one_liner_zh: 该文用常微分方程动力学模型研究酵母铜稳态中转录因子MAC1/ACE1与铜蛋白调控，虽涉及转录因子但非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，且方法为经典动力学而非AI或分子模拟，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Rather than inhibiting copper entry when grown on high Cu, yeast cells import excessive Cu while simultaneously increasing expression of metallothionein CUP1 which then sequesters excess Cu. An ordinary-differential-equations-based kinetic model was developed to investigate this unusual behavior. The assumed reaction network included 25 reactions and 10 components in the cytosol of yeast cells growing in media supplemented with a series of increasing nutrient COPPER concentrations. Published concentrations of copper proteins and coordination complexes that constitutes the low-molecular-mass (or labile) Cu pool were assumed. Other components included transcription factors MAC1 and ACE1, the MAC1-dependent copper importer CTR1, and other copper proteins considered collectively. A second MAC1-independent importer was required for sufficient Cu to enter the cell under Cu-excess conditions. The mathematical system was initially solved at steady state for each condition in the series. The null-space of the stoichiometric matrix was evaluated using the basic pathways approach. Steady-state rates and rate-constants were calculated for each reaction and each condition of the series. Twenty-one rate-constants remained relatively constant across the series, while 4 trended higher, indicating that cells regulate those latter reactions in ways that were not included in their assumed rate-law expressions. This behavior was simulated by augmenting those expressions with logistical functions that sensed labile Cu and/or nutrient COPPER. The resulting integrated dynamical system approximately generated observed component concentrations over the series and was stable to both intracellular and extracellular perturbations. The MAC1-independent importer is predicted to be FET4, a nonspecific importer of both Cu and Fe. Cells may tolerate excessive Cu import to import sufficient iron.
abstract_zh: 酵母细胞在高铜环境下生长时，并非抑制铜的进入，而是过量输入铜，同时增加金属硫蛋白CUP1的表达，后者随后螯合过量的铜。本研究开发了一个基于常微分方程的动力学模型，以探究这一异常行为。假定的反应网络包括酵母细胞胞质中的25个反应和10个组分，这些细胞在补充一系列递增营养COPPER浓度的培养基中生长。采用了已发表的铜蛋白及构成低分子量（或不稳定）铜库的配位复合物的浓度。其他组分包括转录因子MAC1和ACE1、MAC1依赖性铜输入体CTR1，以及其他集体考虑的铜蛋白。在铜过量条件下，需要第二个不依赖MAC1的输入体才能使足够的铜进入细胞。该数学系统首先在系列中每种条件下的稳态下求解。化学计量矩阵的零空间采用基本路径方法进行评估。针对系列中的每个反应和每种条件，计算了稳态速率和速率常数。二十一个速率常数在系列中保持相对恒定，而4个呈上升趋势，表明细胞以未包含在假定速率定律表达式中的方式调控这些后续反应。通过向这些表达式添加感知不稳定铜和/或营养COPPER的逻辑函数来模拟此行为。由此得到的集成动态系统大致生成了系列中观察到的组分浓度，并且对细胞内和细胞外扰动均保持稳定。预测不依赖MAC1的输入体为FET4，这是一种非特异性输入体，可同时输入铜和铁。细胞可能通过耐受过量铜输入来确保足够的铁输入。
